title: Unmanaged guided first-run: product selection -> layer setup -> sign-in -> Healthy

q1_products.note: ADR-M3-005 product-first host step -- renders products, not hosts. Config-driven from ecosystem.yml; see products.sample.json alongside this file. Only asked when the product set is ambiguous (narrow-not-widen); a single-product ecosystem asks 0 questions here.

q2_signin.note: Handled by the mock-cc auth ceremony below, not a free-text answer.

notes: S5's <=3-question bound: Q1 product-first (only if ambiguous), Q2 sign-in (drives mock-cc auth -- initiate then poll until a terminal status), Q3 company (suggested)+department (numbered pick-list, never free-text). Repo-URL/tier setup reuses M2 settings::authoring (out of scope for this fixture -- see settings/ corpus). Healthy is reached only via the fresh doctor status:healthy poll after materialize (ADR-M3-002), reusing corpus/healthy-clean-fleet.json.
